messages:
Lena Ortiz: Heads up 1: Partner asked for a hard embargo handshake and SI readiness checklist for upcoming joint announce (H100/H200, MI300, Gaudi). Need owners.
Arjun Singh: I'll own the marketplace gating side. Need to confirm SKU tags and image hashes. @Vendor Rep - N can you provide the exact CV tag we should expect?
Vendor Rep - N: Tag will be nvidia/cv:h200-2026-04-10. We'll attach release-notes and a minimal smoke script. Expect limited APAC capacity first week.
Maya K.: SI checklist draft: kernel module version, nvlink fw, container image, helm values, performance regression tests (p95/p99), and a fallback routing plan. I'll post the checklist doc later today.
Arjun Singh: For marketplace gating, we need 1) immutable image tag 2) signed SBOM 3) test vectors & perf matrix 4) embargo calendar entry. Legal wants a 48h verification window.
Vendor Rep - Gaudi: For Gaudi/MI300, early SKUs are in a thermal-limited bin. We'll provide a perf-matrix showing expected throughput at 2k/16k/48k seqs. Recommend tagging mi300-quant and mi300-fp16 variants.
Lena Ortiz: Press ops: partners requested a 10-day embargo prior to public PR. We have to align with marketing calendar. Are there any cross-cloud marketplace blockers?
Arjun Singh: Marketplace quotas: we need to reserve promo slots in us-west and eu-west. Also confirm if cloud partners require extra legal AUP signoff. @legal-bot any checks?
legal-bot: Reminder: embargo inclusion requires (a) signed partner MAA, (b) dev preview terms accepted, (c) marketing opt-in form. Notify legal at least 5 business days before public date.
Maya K.: Canary plan proposal: 24h smoke + perf run in staging with 1k requests, then 24h limited production (5% traffic) monitoring p95/p99, error-rate <0.1%. If any perf regression >10% vs baseline, auto-fallback to h100-v1.
Arjun Singh: Add automated rollback on increased 5xx or token cost spike >20% during canary. We'll need a playbook for SI integrators in the event of rollback.
Vendor Rep - N: We'll publish the smoke script snippet: ```#!/bin/bash
for i in {1..1000}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"h200-cv","seq_len":512}'; done```
Maya K.: Also include a kubectl snippet for integrators to validate GPU nodes: ```kubectl get nodes -l accelerator=nvidia -o wide && nvidia-smi -L```
Lena Ortiz: Delivery timelines? Vendor reps: ETA for tags and SBOMs? We need those to finalize marketplace page and embargo window.
Vendor Rep - Gaudi: Perf matrices and SBOM by EOD tomorrow. Image tags by 2026-04-12 morning.
Vendor Rep - N: CV tag and SBOM by 2026-04-12 noon. We'll also share a small set of reference workloads for SI testing.
Arjun Singh: Good. Action items: (1) Maya to post SI checklist (2) Vendors to post tags/SBOMs (3) Arjun to reserve marketplace promo slots and add embargo calendar (4) Lena to align marketing/press windows.
deploy-bot: Canary pipeline queued by @Maya K.  job #5902. Notify channel on completion.
Lena Ortiz: I'll schedule a short cross-org sync tomorrow 9am PT to confirm final dates. Thanks all.
